blind.why: Main menu 1280x720 vs real CS2 main menu (agent showcase). Ours has far stronger hierarchy: one obvious PLAY CTA, match setup visible, numbered list, keyboard hints; lit athlete line-up with reflective floor + ring reads as a premium backdrop. CS2's single hero model is better staged (DOF, one subject, not cropped by panels); ours shows 6+ identical clones in the same aim pose, half hidden behind the setup card.

Settings/Video vs CS2 Video tab. Ours: preset cards with descriptions, live 'Rendering at 1280x720', footer key hints, autosave note. CS2 is cleaner and lets the game show through, but ours explains more and looks finished.

Settings opened from the in-game pause vs CS2 Advanced Video opened in-match. Ours is wrecked by the HUD drawing on top of the modal: radar covers the SETTINGS title and Controls/Video tabs, ROUND 1 banner + beacon toast sit over Callsign, BUY TIME prompt sits on the Readout, money/health/ammo/weapon icons/crosshair over the footer and toggles. CS2 puts the menu above everything.

biggest_gap: Every in-match overlay (pause, settings-from-pause, F1 cheat-sheet, tutorial card) renders BELOW the HUD. Repro: normal URL -> Play -> Esc (or pointer unlock) -> Settings; or press F1 in game. The radar, scorebar, round banner/killfeed toasts, BUY TIME prompt, money/HP/ammo, weapon rail and the crosshair all draw over the panel (shots/critic-menu/pair3.png, f11_pause_settings_1280.png, g_cheat_1280.png, t_pause_live.png crosshair over the SETTINGS button). CS2 hides/dims the HUD and puts the Esc menu on the top layer. Fix: when base is pause or any overlay is open in game, add html.fx-menu-like class that hides HUD/crosshair/toasts (or raise #ui .fx above the HUD stacking context) and dim the world.
other_gaps: First-run tutorial card is placed exactly where the round-start banner ('ROUND 1 / ATTACK - ARM THE BEACON'), the beacon-pickup toast and (at 1920x1080) the '1 vs 0 / ROUND 0/15' scorebar live; texts overprint and are unreadable (f06 in flowsheet.png, g_tutorial-1_1920.png). Hold the tutorial until the banner clears or dock it elsewhere (CS2 trains via side text, never over the round banner).

Keyboard trap: opening Settings from pause by mouse autofocuses the Callsign text input; Esc then does NOT close settings and Resume becomes unreachable without the mouse; letter keys type into the name (f11, flow3 log: ov stays ['settings'] after Esc). Autofocus the tab list, and let Esc blur+close from inputs.

Menu->match transition is a plain cross-fade: for ~1-2 s the HUD, radar, round banner and world are double-exposed through the main menu (f05 in flowsheet.png). CS2 cuts to a loading/black state. Use the wipe to fully cover before the HUD appears.

Placebo settings shipped to players: Motion Blur, Raw Input, Screen Shake and the Announcer volume are stored but (per launch notes and audio code: applyVolumes ignores voiceVolume) have no consumer. Hide or wire them; CS2 never shows dead options.

1280x720 layout sloppiness: crosshair tab 'T-STYLE' wraps to 2 lines, zoom chip '6x' orphaned on its own row, share-code row clipped under the footer; main-menu tip line wraps into a 2nd line touching the screen bottom and crowding the nav hints; CREDITS sits 15 px above BUILD 0.1.0.
Pause screen itself is thin: HUD fully visible and undimmed around it, no map/score context beyond one line, no quick sensitivity/volume; CS2's Esc gives the full menu over a blurred game.

Boot: earliest frame is a CSS splash in a fallback system font (DejaVu oblique) because brand fonts come from Google Fonts CDN (fails offline/behind proxies); self-host Barlow so the splash matches the menu logo.
bugs: HUD + crosshair draw above pause/settings/F1 cheat-sheet overlays (z-order).
Tutorial card overlaps round banner / toasts / scorebar (1280 and 1920).
Settings-from-pause autofocuses Callsign input; Esc cannot close settings (keyboard trap).

Pause opened by a keyboard Esc while pointer lock is still held does not exitPointerLock(); mouse clicks on pause buttons are swallowed by the canvas (Playwright: click on Settings at its centre leaves base=pause, no overlay).
Motion blur / raw input / screen shake / voice volume controls have no effect.
strengths: Main menu is genuinely attractive: bold logo, clear numbered list, strong orange PLAY CTA, match-setup card, live 3D backdrop with reflective floor, rim light and team-coloured athletes.

Settings correctness verified: sensitivity is exact CS scale (100 counts = 2.200 deg at 1.0, 4.400 at 2.0; cm/360 readout 52.0 cm @800dpi correct); FOV is horizontal (90 -> 58.7 v, 110 -> 77.6 v at 16:9); rebinding applies live (K moves, W unbound) with a 'K moved from Move forward' conflict toast; crosshair colour/size/gap apply instantly to the HUD; master volume drives the mixer gain to 0.
Pause freezes match clock and engine; Esc toggles pause<->game; keyboard arrow navigation works on main and pause; F1 cheat-sheet is excellent content.
End-of-match recap is clean and CS2-like (two team tables, MVP, round history, Play again).
No console errors from the menu (only the sandbox's Google-Fonts cert failure).
